rubric.evidence: Every load-bearing claim traced to a primary source fetched live 2026-07-29: PR #192 diff (verbatim IDL + attribute definitions + fuzzing MUST), Chromium speech_recognition_result.idl (RuntimeEnabled=WebSpeechTimestamps gate), speech_recognition_result.cc (std::nullopt null path + FuzzTimestamp with kFuzzInterval = base::Milliseconds(2) and FloorToMultiple), speech_recognition.cc (provisional+final aggregation), speech_recognition.mojom (TimingInformation semantics quoted), runtime_enabled_features.json5 (experimental, not public, no OT), CL 8129198 (merged 2026-07-28), intent thread (Target DevTrial M153, tracking bug 528037568).

Feature id 5811907077472256 confirmed present in the milestone=153 listing under 'In developer trial (Behind a flag)' (the only dev-trial entry; fetched 2026-07-29); slug speechrecognitionresult-timestamps-webspeech-api derived from the exact listing name 'SpeechRecognitionResult Timestamps (WebSpeech API)' per invariant #1.

The entire new surface is two nullable attributes; both get child routes with nine-dimension coverage, and the two cross-cutting contracts (2ms quantization, latency computation) are inventoried as algorithms mapped to overview sections. reference-contract.json claims implementation-sufficient with 4 inventory items × 9 dimensions and 18 sources.

Overview separates mechanism (engine → mojom → Blink → fuzz → getter) from usage (caption alignment, latency failover); explicitly corrects the likely misread that timing is per-word (it is per-result segment; mojom hypothesis parts are not exposed). Engine-semantics provenance (SODA session audio time) is stated as Chromium-pipeline-specific.

Explainer's latency/failover snippet adapted with guards; gendn-derived VTTCue alignment and sliding-window examples labelled as such; quantization example shows concrete floored values. Examples are source-derived but not executed locally (Chrome 153 + flag + suitable engine unavailable).

No BCD key for either attribute (BCD file covers only length/item/isFinal, verified) and no webstatus entry for the attributes — both stated plainly; interim tables labelled non-BCD; host-interface BCD data (Chrome 33 / Safari 14.1 / Firefox never) included for orientation; vendor positions recorded as 'No signal' from the ChromeStatus record, not invented.

All citation labels are direct links (zero plain-text citations); key URLs HEAD/GET-verified during research (explainer blob 200, PR 192 + /files 200, WebAudio fork explainer 200, CPS feature route + 3 concept routes 200, chromium.googlesource IDL/cc/mojom/flag JSON fetched and quoted).

Single h1 per page with sequential h2 sections; tables use th scope=row/col; baseline banner has role=note + aria-label; iframe has a descriptive title and figcaption; soft hyphens in long h1 tokens so wrapping never breaks mid-word.
